119879.synopsis:
Chu Xiu had spent years disguised as a man without a single slip—until her family arranged a marriage for her.
Baffled, Chu Xiu exclaimed, “I may dress like a man, but I’m truly a woman. If I marry a wife… how am I supposed to sleep with her?”
Her sister-in-law, however, misunderstood her concern. “Who says women can’t sleep together? It’s not like you don’t have hands and a mouth.”
Chu Xiu: “…”
To resolve the immediate dilemma, Chu Xiu paid five taels of silver and brought home a beautiful wife.
Her new bride was stunning—enchantingly so—but mute, unable to speak or even use sign language.
On their wedding night, Chu Xiu remained in her male disguise, while the bride merely smiled in silence. After a night together, both were very satisfied.
Chu Xiu thought to herself: Though my bride cannot speak, the occasional muffled moans she lets slip are more seductive than words ever could be—far harder to resist.
In the dim light behind the bed curtains, Chu Xiu held her new wife close, her hand gliding along her spine, kissing her ear again and again, whispering, “I like you so, so much.”

120903.synopsis:
Jiang Shan was always an outstanding student, the kind of “model child” often praised by neighbors and relatives. As she grew up, she was admitted to a prestigious dance academy, became the star performer of a renowned dance troupe, and achieved great success in her career, shining brightly. After marriage, Xu Hao’s career flourished, their family grew wealthy, and with a loving husband and child, Jiang Shan seemed to have reached the pinnacle of life.  
Until one day, she dozed off in a hospital and woke up—only to find herself transported ten years into the past.  
But this rebirth was nothing like she expected.  
Her once-devoted husband was now her younger sister’s lover. The once academically brilliant Jiang Shan had become the “problem child” in the eyes of adults. Even the prestigious dance academy she was supposed to attend had been replaced by a local vocational school.  
And the most bizarre twist? Her younger sister’s ex-boyfriend had somehow become her “fiancé”!

121671.synopsis:
In the nine-tiered imperial palace, everyone has their own ambitions.
The palace maids often whisper among themselves:
– Some just want to survive quietly until the day they’re released from the palace.
– Some harbor romantic dreams of marrying a refined and scholarly nobleman.
Gu Qingshuang once had both dreams.
But after a flood outside the palace claimed her entire family, even the gentle and affectionate nobleman she trusted backed away in fear. Gu Qingshuang realized all his tender words were lies—his vows meant nothing, and they didn’t stop him from marrying a well-matched noble daughter in a grand ceremony.
Shaking her head, she came to a sudden realization:
With nothing left outside the palace, and love proving unreliable, she would build her own path—
A jade staircase reaching the heavens.
She set her sights on supreme power, and the Phoenix Seal that all women envied.
A path embroidered with blood, jade steps paved with white bones.

131399.synopsis:
Their first meeting happened during the first major collaboration between their two corporations.
At first glance, President Yan Nanchen of the other company openly remarked in front of everyone that his tie was not properly fastened, claiming it damaged the company’s image.
Later, this Alpha went on to criticize his tie, his shoes, and even the color of his shirt.
He thought to himself, how unbearably irritating.
One night, by chance, he encountered Yan Nanchen in a bar restroom.
Yan was leaning against the stall door, loosening his tie, his whole body filled with anxiety and agitation.
Out of kindness, he stepped forward and asked, “President Yan, do you need help?”
But just as he reached out his hand, he was suddenly pulled into the stall.
Startled, he looked up and saw Yan Nanchen’s bloodshot, fierce eyes. He swallowed nervously and said, “I am sorry, I don’t think I can help much.”
“…Please,” the man whispered with desperation, “let me mark you, just once.”
Jiang Yi froze. “You… you are Yan Nanchen?”
This lofty Alpha was begging?
Yan let out a bitter laugh, pressing his lips to Jiang Yi’s neck. “I am not Yan Nanchen. I am his twin brother, Chu Beiheng. Someone drugged me, I have entered susceptibility, and I feel terrible. Can you help me?”
From that moment on, they fell deeply in love.
Jiang Yi called “Chu Beiheng” his puppy.
One accident changed everything.
Jiang Yi unexpectedly differentiated into an Omega. In unbearable pain, he begged his lover to mark him.
Not long after, he became pregnant.
Just when he was ready to share this joyful news, he saw the real Chu Beiheng return to the country.
From beginning to end, the one who had been with him, the puppy, was actually Yan Nanchen.
It was never Chu Beiheng.
In heartbreak, Jiang Yi destroyed their home and ran away while carrying the child.
He did not know that Yan Nanchen had already gone mad searching for him.
And truly, he had gone mad.

“11, will you marry your puppy?”

A new era dawns, and the wheel of time rolls forward.

178759.synopsis:
Lin Baiwu was abandoned as a child because he was a shuang’er.
He was taken in and raised by an old carpenter. Though male, he was frail and weak, unable to carry heavy loads or do hard labor. His pregnancy mole was faint as well, making him poor at bearing children.
When he reached marriageable age, not a single person was willing to marry him. Lin Baiwu thought to himself that, at worst, he would simply rely on his father and spend the rest of his life with him.
Until one day, Lin Baiwu picked up a ‘cat’ under a tree. The ‘cat’ was gravely injured, and after treating its wounds, Lin Baiwu softly asked, “Do you eat small fish?”
Yuan Xiao, the dignified king of the mountains, was being treated like a mere house cat, what utter humiliation!
He sneered and turned his head away in disdain. Yet the delicate-looking youth stubbornly placed the small fish in front of him…
“I said I’m not eating it, take it away! Such trivial little fish isn’t worth my notice!” chomp chomp …wait, it’s actually pretty tasty?
Just when Lin Baiwu finally nurses the ‘cat’ back to health, it suddenly disappears.
Until one day, a burly man came to his door, with betrothal gifts lined up from the east end of the village to the west, explicitly naming him as the one he intended to marry.

188231.synopsis:
Strange events are occurring frequently around the world; demons, evil spirits, and indescribable creatures are appearing in people’s lives.
No one knows that Earth is facing the fate of being merged and swallowed by another world.
However, the sudden emergence of a game changes everything.
In this game, players start with godhood and can quickly establish territories and expand their power using resources…
An invisible war against invasion has begun.
While enjoying the game, players contribute and strive to resist the invasion from another world.

190791.synopsis:
Choose. Your own path.
A battlefield scavenger for a mercenary group, the boy Kanata lived a life of scavenging for valuables on the battlefield in order to survive. His only pleasure was picking up the remnants of magic scattered across the battlefield—beautiful pebbles called Magic Dregs (Rubbish). They were clumps of excess magic power generated when a magician activated magic. They simply disappeared as time passed; simply put, they were completely useless garbage. However, in such a harsh environment, these Magic Dregs (Rubbish) were just about the only things Kanata could find beautiful.
One day, amidst the fires of war where a massive reward was promised, the mercenary group was relentlessly and continuously attacked by someone’s magic. It gradually became clear that the attacks were the work of their employer, an aristocratic magician, and it was a betrayal meant to annul their contract. When the mercenary group is forced to stand at the crossroads of malice, what Kanata chooses is――
With resolve and determination in his heart, the boy rises up.
